meta.title: Scher
meta.description: Nine everyday plugins in one bundle: workspace recency sidebar, colour schemes with a taskbar flash on finished turns, right sidebar, remote SSH workspaces, off-work countdown, system monitor, global todos, IM bots and the ComfyUI workbench. Install once and the Plugins page gains one Scher entry with nine rows — or let the agent ask you module by module and install only what you need.
